title: matthiola angelica
intro: Matthiola angelica, commonly known as the 'Angel's Trumpet', is a flowering plant species in the Brassicaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Matthiola angelica include its potential to reduce inflammation, improve cardiovascular health, and exhibit antimicrobial properties, making it useful in the management of fever, cough, and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its sedative, antispasmodic, and expectorant properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenes.
